description: This file defines the Review class within the OpenCart Admin Controller Event namespace. The class handles event-driven actions related to product reviews, including adding, editing, and deleting reviews by scheduling corresponding tasks.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class managing review-related event tasks such as add, edit, and delete review operations.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Schedules a task to add a new review for a product based on provided arguments.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update an existing review and, if necessary, update related review lists when product ID changes.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Schedules a task to delete a review based on review ID.
